findings.issue: אל־מִחוּץ לַמַּחֲנֶה licenses sending to the outside of the camp; «a fuera al campamento» drops the preposition מִ and treats the camp as the destination.
מַחֲנֵיהֶם is plural (their camps); Spanish has singular campamento.

notes: 2mp enviarán is ustedes; the repeated send, 3mp defile, relative, and qal participle are licensed.
